response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong testing culture and open-source contributions, but he falls well short of the role's core minimum qualifications. His C++ experience amounts to roughly six months at National Instruments plus a thesis project, versus the required 8 years, and his infrastructure/distributed-systems exposure (mainly ~2 years at Sociomantic in DLang) is limited compared to the 5 years required. His career centers on web and product engineering rather than cloud compute platforms, and he shows no formal technical-leadership or people-mentoring track record at the level this role demands.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, and community teaching/workshops
Some high-throughput, low-latency systems experience (Sociomantic: millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Broad polyglot experience and self-driven ownership of large projects (GISCollective founder)
concerns: Far below the 8-year C++ requirement (only ~6 months of professional C/C++ work)
Limited large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform experience; career is web/product focused
No formal technical-lead or team-leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering practices and mentoring inclination
